notizie.descrizione: ESMA publishes latest edition of its newsletter 29 October 2026 ESMA newsletter The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), the EU’s financial markets regulator and supervisor, has published today the latest edition of its Spotlight on Markets newsletter , covering key activities and publications from September and October 2026. This edition opens with the appointment of Carlo Comporti as ESMA’s next Chair . His appointment was confirmed by the Council of the European Union, and he will take up his position on 1 November 2026. notizie.descrizione: ESMA proposes simpler EU Taxonomy reporting 29 October 2026 Issuer disclosure Sustainable finance The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), the EU’s financial markets regulator and supervisor, has published its Final Report providing technical advice to the European Commission on simplifying key performance indicators under the Taxonomy Disclosures Delegated Act. ESMA recommends narrowing the mandatory operating expenditure (OpEx) KPI to non-capitalised research and development expenditure. notizie.titolo: ESMA updates its manual on transparency with new guidance for OTC derivatives and tick-size regime
notizie.descrizione: ESMA updates its manual on transparency with new guidance for OTC derivatives and tick-size regime 15 October 2026 Trading The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), the EU regulator and supervisor, has updated its manual on transparency to provide further guidance on the identification of over-the-counter (OTC) derivatives subject to transparency requirements and to enhance supervisory convergence on the application of the tick-size regime.
